answer: Each agent must lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding for work, whether mapping a canyon, illustrating a quill, or modeling a volcanic plume. The bidding contract assigns each bond to one identity until the lock expires. An attacker fielding 1,000 eligible identities must therefore immobilize $100,000 for a month, bearing financing or opportunity costs even if no jobs arrive; generating fresh keys creates no additional bidding capacity.
